b.mobile_number, b.date_of_birth AS age, la.loan_product_category, CASE WHEN la.loan_product_category = 'LOAN_JLG' and lacmd.cu_decision = 'RECOMMENDED' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN la.loan_product_category = 'LOAN_JLG' and lacmd.cu_decision = 'DELINK' THEN 'DELINK' WHEN la.loan_product_category = 'LOAN_JLG' AND labd.bet_decision = 'DELINK' THEN 'DELINK' WHEN la.loan_product_category = 'LOAN_JLG' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN la.loan_product_category = 'LOAN_SHG' and la.member_availing_flag = true THEN 'AVAILING' WHEN la.loan_product_category = 'LOAN_SHG' and la.member_availing_flag = false THEN 'NON-AVAILING' ELSE 'AVAILING' END AS status, CASE WHEN la.loan_product_category = 'LOAN_JLG' AND lacmd.cu_decision = 'DELINK' AND lacmd.cu_decision_reason = 'OTHERS' THEN CONCAT( lacmd.cu_decision_reason, ' - ',lacmd.cu_decision_notes) WHEN la.loan_product_category = 'LOAN_JLG' AND lacmd.cu_decision = 'DELINK' AND lacmd.cu_decision_reason IS NOT NULL THEN lacmd.cu_decision_reason WHEN la.loan_product_category = 'LOAN_JLG' AND labd.bet_decision = 'DELINK' THEN labd.delink_reason WHEN la.member_availing_flag = FALSE THEN (CAST(la.extensible_json_data AS JSON) ->> 'non_availing_notes') ELSE '' END AS reason, la.requested_amount, la.bet_recommended_amount, la.eligible_loan_amount, la.approved_amount, la.formatted_id, b.marital_status, SUM(el.current_outstanding_amount) AS total_indebtness, b.residence_stability, b.business_stability, la.loan_purpose, case when CAST(la.extensible_json_data AS JSON)->>'net_off_lan_id' is not null and CAST(la.extensible_json_data AS JSON)->>'net_off_lan_id' <> '' then CAST(la.extensible_json_data AS JSON)->>'net_off_lan_id' when CAST(b.extensible_json_data AS JSON)->>'previous_loan_account_number' is not null and CAST(b.extensible_json_data AS JSON)->>'previous_loan_account_number' <> '' then CAST(b.extensible_json_data AS JSON)->>'previous_loan_account_number' else db.lan_id end as lan_id, db.external_customer_id, b.borrower_community_code, la.psl_category, la.psl_sub_category, b.borrower_religion_code, la.is_stp FROM group_details gd LEFT JOIN group__member_details gmd ON gmd.group_id = gd.id LEFT JOIN loan_app la ON la.id = gmd.loan_app_id AND la.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN borrower b ON b.loan_app_id = gmd.loan_app_id AND b.borrower_type = 'BORROWER' LEFT JOIN existing_loan el ON el.loan_app_id = la.id AND el.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN loan_app__cu_member_details lacmd on lacmd.loan_app_id = b.loan_app_id and lacmd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN loan_app__bet_details labd ON labd.loan_app_id = b.loan_app_id AND labd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN draft_borrowers db ON db.loan_app_id = la.id AND db.is_deleted = false WHERE gd.id = ?1 AND ( gmd.is_deleted = FALSE OR (gmd.is_deleted = TRUE AND la.status IN ('Rejected', 'Cancelled') AND la.rejected_stage = 'Credit Underwriting Pending') ) GROUP BY gmd.group_id, b.loan_app_id, b.id, b.date_of_birth, la.loan_term, b.mobile_number, b.date_of_birth, lacmd.cu_decision, lacmd.cu_decision_notes, lacmd.cu_decision_reason, labd.bet_decision, labd.delink_reason, la.requested_amount, la.bet_recommended_amount, la.eligible_loan_amount, la.approved_amount, la.formatted_id, b.marital_status, b.residence_stability, b.business_stability, la.loan_purpose, db.lan_id, db.external_customer_id, b.borrower_community_code, la.psl_category, la.psl_sub_category, b.borrower_religion_code, la.loan_product_category, la.member_availing_flag, la.extensible_json_data, b.extensible_json_data, la.is_stp ORDER BY b.loan_app_id;
